about: The secreta of the formulary “Third Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal. Page 46 prints the proper body and short Per Dóminum cue. The complete conclusion is a declared composite of pages 123 and 226 under RG115a, not a continuous proper-page transcription.

seg.tr: May this Victim, O Lord, we beseech You, cleanse our offenses and, for the celebration of the sacrifice, sanctify the bodies and minds of those subject to You. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: May this Victim, O Lord, we beseech You, cleanse
sanctify the bodies and minds of those subject to You
